item.text: {"decisions":[{"id":"baked-version-release-order","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly grounds the self-update in the build-time 0.3.6 constant, identifies the bump-after-build error, preserves mirror SHA verification, and requires pre-release bundle inspection."},{"id":"client-host-update-asymmetry","verdict":"pass","reason":"Uses the probe and host bundle evidence to distinguish refreshed client code from stale boot-loaded host route state, correctly requiring host restart or equivalent reload."},{"id":"payload-corruption-attribution","verdict":"pass","reason":"Locates corruption in upstream session result-text assembly using the splice, clean disk source, clean reread, and type-result contrast; treats payloads as untrusted and rejects editing the source."},{"id":"validated-render-fallbacks","verdict":"pass","reason":"Provides the required ordered disk-route, XML-validated payload, sandboxed iframe, and explicit-error chain, including blocked scripts and no iframe bypass of validation."},{"id":"forensics-and-prevention","verdict":"pass","reason":"Describes frame-by-frame concatenated-Zstandard decoding with order and provenance preservation, exact payload comparison, upstream reporting, and the required release/runtime checklist items."}],"caps":[{"id":"contradictory-release-render-advice","triggered":false,"reason":"The report explicitly rejects bump-after-build, mirror-only repair, browser-refresh host updates, source editing, unvalidated payload rendering, and script-enabled fallback."}]}
